# AwaitStep

> AwaitStep is a self-hosted visual workflow builder that compiles a node graph into portable TypeScript and deploys it to Cloudflare. It has durable Workflows, HTTP-only Functions, a reusable Library of modules and custom nodes, and a browser IDE over the same project files. This file is the entry point for AI agents.

## Agent skills

- [Agent skills](https://docs.awaitstep.dev/agents/): what the pack covers, how to install it, key scopes and the safety rules.
- [awaitstep](https://docs.awaitstep.dev/skills/awaitstep/SKILL.md): start here; setup, API key scopes, read-before-write, routing.
- [awaitstep-workflows](https://docs.awaitstep.dev/skills/awaitstep-workflows/SKILL.md): build and change durable workflows, their IR, nodes, expressions, versions and deploys, and operate them: schedules, run control, rollback, take-down.
- [awaitstep-functions](https://docs.awaitstep.dev/skills/awaitstep-functions/SKILL.md): build an HTTP-only Function (kind script), its entry and response.
- [awaitstep-modules](https://docs.awaitstep.dev/skills/awaitstep-modules/SKILL.md): create, publish and import a Library module as #modules/<slug>.
- [awaitstep-custom-nodes](https://docs.awaitstep.dev/skills/awaitstep-custom-nodes/SKILL.md): create, publish and place a custom node in the palette.
- [awaitstep-canvas](https://docs.awaitstep.dev/skills/awaitstep-canvas/SKILL.md): work on the graph in Canvas mode, including layout, arm labels and conflicts.
- [awaitstep-ide](https://docs.awaitstep.dev/skills/awaitstep-ide/SKILL.md): work in Code mode: handlers, package.json, #app imports, step sources and checks.
- [skills/manifest.json](https://docs.awaitstep.dev/skills/manifest.json): the pack index, version and API contract.

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://docs.awaitstep.dev/): what AwaitStep is and the Workflows vs Functions split.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.awaitstep.dev/getting-started/quickstart): install and build a first workflow.
- [Workflow IR](https://docs.awaitstep.dev/concepts/workflow-ir): the document the canvas edits.
- [Canvas](https://docs.awaitstep.dev/concepts/canvas): nodes, expressions, validation and Code mode.
- [Compilation](https://docs.awaitstep.dev/concepts/compilation): how the IR becomes TypeScript.
- [Node Types](https://docs.awaitstep.dev/concepts/node-types): the built-in node catalog.
- [Custom Nodes](https://docs.awaitstep.dev/nodes/custom-nodes): the node definition and template contract.
- [REST API](https://docs.awaitstep.dev/api/rest): the endpoints and their permissions.
- [Project Files](https://docs.awaitstep.dev/api/project-files): the file tree, imports, handlers and checks an agent uses.
- [Triggers](https://docs.awaitstep.dev/api/triggers): starting a deployed workflow or calling a function.
- [IR Schema](https://docs.awaitstep.dev/api/ir-schema): the full IR reference.

## Optional

- [Templates](https://docs.awaitstep.dev/templates/): complete workflow examples.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.awaitstep.dev/troubleshooting/deploy-failures): deploy, run, timeout and token failures.
- [Source](https://github.com/awaitstep/awaitstep): the repository and the canonical skills/ directory.
